discord.title: Discord Rich Presence
discord.description: Show your friends what you're playing, requires Discord to be running.

extensions.title: Extensions and integrations
extensions.description: Crowdsourced enhancements from the FOSS community: SponsorBlock skips, DeArrow titles and Return YouTube Dislike.
extensions.resetStatsBody: This clears your saved-time and skipped-segment counts.
extensions.sponsorBlockDescription: Automatically skip sponsored and promotional segments.
extensions.deArrowDescription: Replace clickbait titles and thumbnails with crowdsourced ones.
extensions.deArrowBadgeDescription: Show a small badge next to titles cleaned by DeArrow.
extensions.returnDislikeDescription: Fetch and display estimated public dislike counts.
extensions.apiServerDescription: Endpoint used to fetch and submit skip segments.
extensions.submitSegmentsDescription: Show a submit button in the player and contribute segments.
extensions.submissionIdPlaceholder: No ID set, generate or paste one
extensions.submissionIdNote: Your ID is a random string that anonymously credits your submissions. Keep it private.
